verses.2: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.3: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.4: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.5: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
verses.6: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

verses.23: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.24: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.27: And those officers provided victual for king
verses.28: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.31: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.32: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.33: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
